issues.quote: total liabilities rose more modestly to $43.0 billion from $36.4 million
issues.problem: Unit error: fiscal 2022 total liabilities were $36.4 billion, not million.

issues.quote: Profitability kept pace, as net income grew 19.4% to $15.0 billion
issues.problem: Misleading: net income growth came from a one-time ~$5.9B non-cash deferred tax valuation allowance release. Operating income fell from ~$13.7B to ~$8.9B and operating margin dropped from ~16.8% to ~9.2%.

issues.quote: That divergence from earnings growth warrants monitoring
issues.problem: The gap is explained by the non-cash tax benefit and lower operating profits. It shows weaker earnings quality, not an unexplained anomaly.

data.summary: The numbers are mostly correct, but 2022 liabilities should be $36.4 billion, not million. The claim that profitability kept pace is misleading because a one-time tax benefit drove net income growth while operating income fell sharply.
